tickets.title: Prepare destination note for sale proceeds
tickets.text: Prepare a concise destination note for Raina Bramblequill covering operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and CPA and attorney questions following her sale of 80% of Cloudberry Kite Design Studio to Silver Marmot Holdings. Reference the $2,765,000 Teacup Comet Bank deposit, the $4.6 million gross consideration, the $350,000 indemnity escrow holdback, and the $1.74 million in Velvet Acorn Custody accounts.
tickets.evidence: Raina asked for a concise destination note covering operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and CPA and attorney questions; the agreed follow-up is due January 10, 2025.

tickets.title: Obtain executed escrow agreement and working-capital schedule
tickets.text: Obtain from Raina Bramblequill's sale file the executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule that are missing from the Cloudberry Kite Design Studio sale to Silver Marmot Holdings. These documents are needed to reconcile net proceeds, since the closing binder and the Teacup Comet Bank deposit differed without identifying escrow, advisory fees, legal fees, or working-capital adjustments.
tickets.evidence: The agreed January 3, 2025 follow-up is to obtain the executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule missing from the sale file.
